expected_level_description: You can: - make sound clinical judgements about the effect of digital services on care - challenge unsafe practice, in digital or clinical settings, with confidence - support other clinicians to apply their professional standards to digital work

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

skill: Human factors and usability in clinical systems
expected_level_description: You can: - take part in usability tests and simulations of clinical tasks - spot common design hazards, such as similar-looking options or hidden alerts
You can: - follow a software life cycle process that meets medical device standards - produce the records that such a process requires
You can: - give clinical input to product teams on workflows and safety - help clinical colleagues adopt new systems

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly

You can: - work collaboratively in a group and build relationships with others - identify issues through Agile 'health checks' and work with others to address them - manage stakeholder expectations - be flexible and capable of proactive and reactive communication - host or moderate difficult discussions within the team or with senior stakeholders

You can: - work with risk owners to advise and give feedback - advise on risk impact and whether it's within risk tolerance - describe different risk methodologies and how these are applied, as well as the proportionality of risk
